Challenge: Reliant on "champs" to resolve tickets and then manually update Freshdesk tickets. This creates a bottleneck and delays in data analysis.
Impact: Reduced efficiency, longer resolution times, and a suboptimal customer experience.
Limited Agent Capacity Visibility:

Challenge: Difficulty in accurately determining which agent has the highest chat volume or is best suited to handle specific customer inquiries. This can lead to uneven workload distribution and missed opportunities to optimize agent utilization.
Impact: Decreased agent productivity, longer wait times for customers, and potential for customer dissatisfaction.
